intervention: Prescription-strength omega-3 fatty acid (EPA and DHA) supplements
summary: High doses of EPA and DHA lower triglycerides substantially in people with high levels. These doses are used under medical supervision; ordinary over-the-counter capsules contain much less.
whyThisGrade: Many randomised trials, reviewed by the American Heart Association
caution: High doses can increase bleeding risk together with blood thinners.

studies.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids for the Management of Hypertriglyceridemia: A Science Advisory From the American Heart Association
